purpose: implementation census of literature factors under personal long-only whole-share constraints; not alpha discovery

data.splits: data/runtime/strategy_c/raw/splits, back-adjust: prices before execution_date multiplied by split_from/split_to
data.universe_snapshots: CS_*.json.gz in strategy_c/raw/tickers and research_universe_u1/reference/tickers; snapshot = latest as_of <= signal date
data.sic: SEC submissions sic via snapshot cik (diagnostic only)
data.dividends: NOT AVAILABLE: price return for portfolios and all benchmarks

universe.adv_rule: median of unadjusted close*volume over sessions [i-19, i], NaN skipped, >= 5000000
universe.excluded_reason: residual split-adjustment jump in prevalidation E

features.daily_return: adjusted close(s)/adjusted close(s-1) - 1 over consecutive stored sessions; NaN if either missing

MOM12_2.valid_if: adjclose[i-21] and adjclose[i-252] present AND >= 200 non-NaN daily returns among sessions [i-251, i-21]
MOM12_2.rank: descending value, ties by ticker ascending

LOWVOL252.literature: trailing 1-year daily realized volatility (S&P 500 Low Volatility / MSCI min-vol practice); AHXZ 2006 low-vol anomaly
LOWVOL252.value: sample std (ddof=1) of daily returns over sessions [i-251, i]
LOWVOL252.valid_if: >= 200 non-NaN daily returns in the window
LOWVOL252.rank: ascending value, ties by ticker ascending

features.ranked_set: eligible names with a valid feature on the signal session

calendar.signal_session: last stored session of each calendar month
calendar.execution_session: next stored session after the signal session

portfolio.weighting: equal target at entry only; market-cap weighting forbidden
portfolio.hold_zone: rank <= floor(0.20 * ranked_set_size); a holding outside it (or ineligible, or feature invalid) is SOLD
portfolio.drift_rule: membership change only: existing holdings are never trimmed or topped up
portfolio.target_usd: 0.05 * NAV at signal close (cash + shares * unadjusted signal close); initial build 500
portfolio.sizing_price: unadjusted close of the signal session (known when the order is placed)
portfolio.whole_share_skip: shares_planned == 0 (price > target) -> candidate skipped, next entry-zone candidate in rank order is tried
portfolio.buy_order: entry-zone candidates not held, in rank order, until holdings == N or entry zone exhausted
portfolio.cash_constraint: if shares_planned * fill * (1+cost) > cash, decrement shares by 1 until it fits; if 0 -> cash-constrained skip and buying STOPS for this rebalance
portfolio.sell_proceeds: available for buys in the same execution session (sells processed first)

execution_reference.intended_live_order: Kiwoom REST LOC (trde_tp 30) on the execution session
execution_reference.fill_price: unadjusted close of the execution session
execution_reference.fill_assumption: close is not a guaranteed fill; friction is inside the 40 bp cost
execution_reference.missing_close_on_execution: sell at last available close, flagged; not bought
execution_reference.delisting_or_price_stop: position valued at last available close until the next execution, then sold at that price, flagged
execution_reference.split_handling: position value follows adjusted close ratio; share count does not need re-basing

cost.applied_to: every fill notional; regulatory fees on sells only, in all scenarios including 0 bp

benchmarks.interpretation: implementation sanity only; no premium claim from 12 months

measurements: monthly eligible N, ranked_set N, entry/hold zone size
one-way turnover per rebalance = (buys + sells) / (2 * NAV before trades), initial build excluded
annualized turnover = sum over the 12 rebalances
transaction-cost drag = costs (initial build excluded) / mean NAV, annualized
realized weights after each rebalance: min, max, std, HHI
top holding weight at month ends
returns: gross (0 bp + regulatory), net 40 bp, minus SPY, RSP, factor ETF

implementable_gates.note: numeric thresholds added at freeze by the implementer (contract section 14 is qualitative); all must pass per factor
implementable_gates.G1_coverage: valid feature / eligible >= 0.90 at every signal
implementable_gates.G2_cross_section: ranked_set >= 500 at every signal (entry zone >= 50 = 2.5 N)
implementable_gates.G3_holdings: post-rebalance holdings >= 18 at >= 11 of 13 executions and >= 15 at all 13
implementable_gates.G5_turnover: annualized one-way turnover <= 3.0 (MOM12_2) / <= 1.2 (LOWVOL252); 1.5x the prevalidation band estimate (1.99 / 0.77); equivalent 40 bp cost drag about <= 2.4% / <= 1.0% per year
implementable_gates.G6_corporate_action: 0 held-position days with |adjusted daily return| > 50% within 2 sessions of a split execution_date of that ticker
implementable_gates.G7_determinism: two independent runs produce identical trade-log sha256
implementable_gates.G8_no_collapse: cash never negative, NAV finite every session, holdings never 0 after the initial build
implementable_gates.returns: NOT a gate; a negative 12-month return does not fail the factor

paper_promotion: IMPLEMENTABLE is necessary, not sufficient; paper requires a separate user decision and a LOC fill-behavior contract
